paragraphs: QQQ is -0.70% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -17/100 (Cautiously Negative). Score path: pre-market -5 → now -17; open -10 → now -17 (deteriorated 7 points).

The main live drivers are Semiconductors are a headwind: Previous regular-session close · SOX -2.67% | Nasdaq -0.44% | SOX vs Nasdaq -2.23 pp | SOXX vs Nasdaq -2.16 pp | SMH vs Nasdaq -1.61 pp. The 2Y rate signal is a headwind: 4.791% (+3.5 bp vs prev close). Mega-caps are a headwind: After-hours · 7-stock basket -0.04% | 1/7 positive | QQQ -0.05% | relative +0.01 pp. It changed from positive to negative after the baseline snapshot.
The downside move is broadly confirmed by Nasdaq internals (semiconductors negative, mega-caps negative, breadth mixed).

What would change the view: improvement would require a sustained 10Y move back below roughly 5.05%, semiconductors regaining leadership versus QQQ, broader participation. Deterioration would be reinforced by the 10Y remaining above 5.05% or extending higher, a material volatility expansion.
